label: Petri Dishes for Fossil Fragments
description: Small, clear, shallow dishes with lids used to sort, contain, and temporarily store very small fossil fragments or isolated micro-fossils during preparation.

components.function: Protects contents from dust and loss.
Area for writing specimen numbers or notes to avoid mixing fragments.

game_mechanics.fragment_sorting: Player must sort tiny bone fragments into labeled petri dishes to reconstruct a complete skeleton.
game_mechanics.loss_prevention: Failure to use petri dishes or label them correctly results in 'lost' fragments.
